verdict.rationale: Llama's docs mention agent-optimized inference and function calling (llama-docs-2, llama-docs-15) and even a 'multi-agent coding in terminal' tagline (llama-docs-12), suggesting agentic capabilities are within the product's scope, but there is no evidence of any feature letting a user configure or schedule automations that run autonomously in the background — Llama is a model/weights distribution with CLI download/verify tools (llama-gh-1 to llama-gh-6), not an automation or scheduling platform. Missing for 10: any documented scheduler, trigger system, or persistent background-agent runtime; any first-party or community evidence of autonomous automation setup.
